title: Validation evidence and retained-future comparison
summary: Validation returns evidence objects with fold membership, expected/predicted values and frozen model state. Retained model branches can be compared without changing the caller's live branch/controller position.
authority: Executable source/tests and supplied upstream API artifacts are authoritative; this sphere preserves architecture and continuity.
invariants: A validation score is accompanied by dataset/plan/model-state evidence.
Each cross-validation fold trains an independent model on its explicit train subset.
Branch comparison evaluates the same evidence dataset against both retained futures.
Analytical comparison restores the original live journal point and does not silently promote either branch.
procedure: Use MLCrossValidator with a model factory and explicit metric.
Inspect MLValidationEvidence/MLFoldResult rather than relying on a bare aggregate.
Use MLBranchComparator to rank retained futures under explicit minimize/maximize direction.

provenance.claim: Cross-validation evidence and non-destructive branch comparison.
Regression proves branch comparison restores the original live point.
